entries.hypothesis: Live 2026 only: the frozen model was calibrated in this band on the Jan-Apr 2026 holdout (1,437 rows, 51.6% vs 52.4%). Live 10-25..11-14 the whole 1.5-1.9 expected-shots range is low on 2+ shots (.45-.50 43.5% vs 47.5%, .50-.55 45.3% vs 52.5%, .55-.60 53.6% vs 57.7%) while 3+ shots is on target, and the market priced the band like the model (51.6%). Candidates: (1) noise, about 3 standard errors over ~1,000 rows; (2) wider game-to-game spread in 2026 for mid-volume shooters (holdout variance/mean 1.09-1.16); (3) 2026 league shot-rate drift; (4) ice-time role changes the 10-game inputs lag. Step 1 (2026-11-15): level and spread minor, TOI role not the cause; leading cause is the 2026 PP TOI shift (P2.45): light-PP players overpredicted (0.25-2 min, 35-45% vs ~51%), 3+ min underpredicted (58% vs 54%); holdout flat in every PP group.
entries.next_step: Investigate P2.45 (official PP minutes vs stored, sample games): data defect -> data fix; real extra power plays -> PP input relative to league level or 2026 refit, as a shadow with operator approval. Recheck 11-22.
